description: Test suite for helper functions related to XAI tool authentication, including resolving fallback API keys and checking if the XAI tool is enabled.

methods.name: isXaiToolEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the XAI tool is enabled based on configuration flags.

methods.name: resolveFallbackXaiAuth
methods.description: Resolves fallback authentication information for XAI tools, either from plugin config or tools web search config.

methods.name: resolveFallbackXaiApiKey
methods.description: Determines the API key to use, preferring plugin config over legacy keys, and handling source metadata.

methods.name: resolveXaiToolApiKey
methods.description: Resolves the API key for the XAI tool, with fallbacks to runtime config, source config, or environment variable.
